positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibrationVerified
positions.frame: how is the calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph established and attested in this record?
positions.why: The prose narrative (src-1) and the two structured field entries (src-2, src-3) all assert the same settled fact — instrument calibrated at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates — from two registers (free-text account and field-labeled metadata) that reinforce rather than diverge from one another. Directional reads align: all three sit at plain-assertion/claim conviction, present-realis-concrete temporal footing, and the same technical field-label register (mint-1), with no hedge or dispute anywhere in the set. No tension to hold; the group is the single verified-status record read twice.
